aliases: naproxen sodium (nsaid) fever reducer/ pain reliever
es.summary: El naproxeno es un antiinflamatorio no esteroideo (AINE) que alivia dolor leve‑moderado y reduce fiebre.
key_points: Alivia dolor muscular, articular, menstrual y cefalea.
Puede causar irritación gástrica y riesgo de sangrado gastrointestinal.
Contraindicado en pacientes con úlcera péptica activa o insuficiencia renal grave.
Se administra oralmente; la forma de sodio tiene inicio de acción más rápido.
Monitorear signos de sangrado y función renal durante el tratamiento.

mechanism: Inhibe la ciclooxigenasa (COX‑1 y COX‑2), disminuyendo la síntesis de prostaglandinas inflamatorias.
Reduce la sensibilización de los nociceptores al dolor.
Disminuye la fiebre al actuar sobre el centro termorregulador del hipotálamo.
indications: Dolor leve‑moderado por artritis, lumbalgia, dolor muscular.
contraindications: Úlcera péptica activa o historial de sangrado gastrointestinal.
Embarazo en el tercer trimestre y lactancia (usar con precaución).
interactions: Aumenta el riesgo de sangrado con anticoagulantes (warfarina) y antitrombóticos.
Potencia la toxicidad renal con inhibidores de la ECA o diuréticos.
Reduce la eficacia de antihipertensivos (IECA, ARB, diuréticos).
Puede aumentar la toxicidad de metotrexato.
nursing_care: Evaluar antecedentes de úlcera, sangrado y función renal antes de administrar.
Obtener presión arterial y frecuencia cardíaca antes y durante el tratamiento.
Monitorear signos de sangrado: melena, hematoquecia, hematomas.
Retener la dosis si el paciente presenta dolor abdominal intenso o vómitos con sangre.
Notificar al médico si hay aumento de creatinina o disminución de diuresis.
patient_teaching: Tomar el medicamento con alimentos o leche para minimizar irritación gástrica.
Evitar el consumo simultáneo de alcohol y otros AINEs.
Reportar cualquier sangrado inusual, hematomas o dolor abdominal persistente.
No exceder la dosis recomendada ni la duración del tratamiento sin indicación médica.
Mantener hidratación adecuada y evitar uso prolongado sin control médico.

outcomes: Sin evidencia de sangrado gastrointestinal: melena o hematoquecia ausentes
Hemoglobina estable: no disminución >2 g/dL en 48 h

interventions.action: Evaluar historial de úlcera, sangrado y uso de anticoagulantes antes de iniciar naproxeno.
interventions.rationale: Identificar factores de riesgo para prevenir complicaciones hemorrágicas.

interventions.action: Monitorear signos de sangrado (hematomas, melena, hematoquecia) cada 8 h.
interventions.rationale: Detectar hemorragia temprana y actuar rápidamente.

interventions.action: Obtener hemograma completo y niveles de hemoglobina al iniciar y a los 3‑5 días de terapia.
interventions.rationale: Evaluar pérdida de sangre oculta y ajustar tratamiento.

interventions.action: Educar al paciente sobre la importancia de reportar cualquier sangrado o dolor abdominal intenso.
interventions.rationale: Facilitar la detección precoz de eventos adversos.

interventions.action: Retener la dosis y notificar al médico si aparecen signos de sangrado gastrointestinal.
interventions.rationale: Prevenir complicaciones graves y permitir intervención médica o cambio de terapia.

aliases: naproxen sodium (nsaid) fever reducer/ pain reliever
en.summary: Naproxen is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) that relieves mild‑to‑moderate pain and reduces fever.
key_points: Relieves muscular, joint, menstrual, and headache pain.
Can cause gastric irritation and risk of gastrointestinal bleeding.
Contraindicated in patients with active peptic ulcer or severe renal insufficiency.
Administered orally; the sodium form has a faster onset of action.
Monitor for signs of bleeding and renal function during treatment.

mechanism: Inhibits cyclooxygenase (COX‑1 and COX‑2), decreasing synthesis of inflammatory prostaglandins.
Decreases fever by acting on the hypothalamic thermoregulatory center.
indications: Mild‑to‑moderate pain from arthritis, low back pain, muscular pain.
contraindications: Active peptic ulcer or history of gastrointestinal bleeding.
Pregnancy in the third trimester and lactation (use with caution).
interactions: Increases bleeding risk with anticoagulants (warfarin) and antithrombotics.
Potentiates renal toxicity with ACE inhibitors or diuretics.
Reduces efficacy of antihypertensives (ACEI, ARB, diuretics).
nursing_care: Assess history of ulcer, bleeding, and renal function before administration.
Obtain blood pressure and heart rate before and during treatment.
Monitor for signs of bleeding: melena, hematochezia, bruising.
Hold dose if patient experiences severe abdominal pain or vomiting with blood.
Notify physician if creatinine rises or urine output decreases.
patient_teaching: Take medication with food or milk to minimize gastric irritation.
Avoid simultaneous consumption of alcohol and other NSAIDs.
Report any unusual bleeding, bruising, or persistent abdominal pain.
Do not exceed the recommended dose or duration without medical indication.
Maintain adequate hydration and avoid prolonged use without medical supervision.

outcomes: No evidence of gastrointestinal bleeding: absence of melena or hematochezia
Stable hemoglobin: no decrease >2 g/dL in 48 h

interventions.action: Assess ulcer, bleeding, and anticoagulant history before initiating naproxen.
interventions.rationale: Identify risk factors to prevent hemorrhagic complications.

interventions.action: Monitor for bleeding signs (bruising, melena, hematochezia) every 8 h.
interventions.rationale: Detect early hemorrhage and act promptly.

interventions.action: Obtain complete blood count and hemoglobin levels at initiation and at 3‑5 days of therapy.
interventions.rationale: Evaluate occult blood loss and adjust treatment.

interventions.action: Educate patient on importance of reporting any bleeding or severe abdominal pain.
interventions.rationale: Facilitate early detection of adverse events.

interventions.action: Hold dose and notify physician if gastrointestinal bleeding signs appear.
interventions.rationale: Prevent serious complications and allow medical intervention or therapy change.

summary.0.quote: Naproxen sodium USP, 220 mg (naproxen 200 mg) (NSAID)* *nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug PURPOSE Pain reliever/fever reducer

key_points.0.quote: Uses temporarily relieves minor aches and pains due to: backache muscular aches minor pain of arthritis menstrual cramps headache toothache the common cold temporarily reduces fever

key_points.1.quote: Stomach bleeding warning: This product contains an NSAID, which may cause severe stomach bleeding.

sections.indications.0.quote: Uses temporarily relieves minor aches and pains due to: backache muscular aches minor pain of arthritis menstrual cramps headache toothache the common cold temporarily reduces fever

sections.indications.2.quote: Uses temporarily relieves minor aches and pains due to: backache muscular aches minor pain of arthritis menstrual cramps headache toothache the common cold temporarily reduces fever

sections.contraindications.0.quote: The chance is higher if you: are age 60 or older have had stomach ulcers or bleeding problems take a blood thinning (anticoagulant) or steroid drug take other drugs containing prescription or nonprescription NSAIDs (aspirin, ibuprofen, naproxen, or others) have 3 or more alcoholic drinks every day while using this product take more or for a longer time than directed

sections.contraindications.2.quote: DO NOT USE if you have ever had an allergic reaction to any other pain reliever/fever reducer right before or after heart surgery

sections.contraindications.3.quote: It is especially important not to use naproxen sodium at 20 weeks or later in pregnancy unless definitely directed to do so by a doctor because it may cause problems in the unborn child or complications during delivery.

sections.patient_teaching.3.quote: do not take more than directed the smallest effective dose should be used drink a full glass of water with each dose
